tasks.natural_request: In scripts/dogfood_trace_event.py, make dry-run reporting precise while preserving its consent and safety boundaries. When every hard gate passes but --execute is absent, return YELLOW with write_blocker execute_not_requested. Use write_blocker capture_disabled_or_consent_missing only when --execute is present but capture or consent still blocks the append. Update the module description to say that writes require both --execute and explicit valid local consent, and update the emitted consent_scope to dogfood_metadata_only_v1. Preserve metadata-only accounting, zero training performed by the logger, zero external inference or teacher calls, zero public-benchmark use, no fallback returns, and no raw user or assistant text. Add focused coverage in tests/test_dogfood_outcome_accounting.py.
